title: Integrum - Reflection based MCP server from any Python Module/Library [P]
summary: Hi! I wrote a small library called Integrum that allows you to quickly create MCP server(s) from existing Python libraries or modules. It has a CLI so it is really easy to use (I hope!). It is open-source (MIT) and on PyPI, so sharing it here if somebody finds it useful. Code: ht
reason: Reddit [P] post announces a new open-source (MIT) developer library 'Integrum' on PyPI that generates MCP servers from Python modules; this is a new developer tool launch covered by the tools-oss rule.
